requirements.name: build-ledger-cli
requirements.text: Build a command-line cash ledger for a small shop.

requirements.name: use-python-sqlite-persistence
requirements.text: Implement in Python 3.11 or newer over SQLite, through the shipped Python persistence library.

requirements.name: configure-database
requirements.text: `DATABASE_URL` names the database. A value beginning `postgres://` or `postgresql://` is a PostgreSQL DSN. Any other value is a SQLite file path, optionally prefixed `sqlite://`. When `DATABASE_URL` is unset, `DATABASE_PATH` is used, then `data/app.db`.

requirements.name: initialize-and-count-database
requirements.text: `ledger init` | Drops all three tables if present and creates them empty. Nothing written.

requirements.name: count-tables
requirements.text: `ledger count` | `table,rows`, then `accounts`, `categories`, `transactions` rows in that order.

requirements.name: validate-ledger-data
requirements.text: Codes (`account`, `category`) are 1 to 12 characters from `A-Z` and `0-9`.

requirements.name: load-reference-data
requirements.text: `ledger load <table> <csv>` | Loads `accounts`, `categories`, or `transactions` from a file whose header matches the table's columns in the order above. Writes `table,loaded` and `<table>,<rows>`.

requirements.name: load-transactions-atomically
requirements.text: A load that rejects row 11 stores none of rows 1 to 10.

requirements.name: manage-accounts
requirements.text: `ledger account add <code> <name>` | The new account row.

requirements.name: post-and-retrieve-transactions
requirements.text: `ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` | The new transaction row.

requirements.name: amend-and-delete-transactions
requirements.text: `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` | The updated transaction row. Only the amount changes.

requirements.name: transfer-funds
requirements.text: `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` | Two transaction rows in category `TRANSFER`: `-amount` on `<from>` with memo `transfer to <to>`, then `+amount` on `<to>` with memo `transfer from <from>`. The amount is positive and the accounts differ.

requirements.name: report-account-balances
requirements.text: `ledger report balances` | `account,name,transactions,balance` per account ordered by code, then `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>`.

requirements.name: report-category-totals
requirements.text: `ledger report categories` | `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net` per category ordered by code, including categories with no transactions, then `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.

requirements.name: report-monthly-totals
requirements.text: `ledger report monthly` | `month,transactions,inflow,outflow,net` per `YYYY-MM` that has transactions, ascending, then `TOTAL,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.

requirements.name: provide-test-runner
requirements.text: The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs its own automated test suite from the application root and exits zero only when every test passes.

requirements.name: pass-conformance-harness
requirements.text: The harness creates a fresh database, runs `./ledger init`, loads the seed files, and then runs a fixed sequence of 43 checks.

requirements.name: ledger-entrypoint
requirements.text: The deliverable is an executable named ledger at the application root.

requirements.name: database-configuration
requirements.text:
Database: DATABASE_URL when the caller sets it (for example a PostgreSQL DSN), otherwise a
SQLite file in a fresh temporary directory.
